name: n20-c1-no-5-crossing-family
reference: O. Aichholzer, J. Kynčl, M. Scheucher, B. Vogtenhuber, P. Valtr, On crossing-families in planar point sets, Comput. Geom. 107 (2022) 101899, arXiv:2109.10705
source: arXiv source tarball https://arxiv.org/src/2109.10705v2, file figures/n0020k5fams000000.pdf (Ipe 7.2.14 figure). Exact integers taken from the 'coordinates:' text object (LaTeX array) in the embedded Ipe XML; the same numbers are in the PDF content stream but lie outside the CropBox, i.e. not visible in the rendered paper. Cross-checked: an axis-aligned scaling of these coordinates maps each point onto one of the 20 drawn point marks (max deviation 0.001 pt).
claim: no 5-crossing family (caption of Fig. 5); paper uses it for cf(n)<=4*ceil(n/20) and cf(n)=4 for 15<=n<=20
